title: Hearing on emergency response in the Rockaways and isolated areas
summary: The Committee on Fire and Emergency Management will examine how FDNY, NYCEM and other agencies coordinate emergency response and communication in geographically isolated communities like the Rockaways and Broad Channel. The hearing will look at displacement services, coordination with nonprofits like the American Red Cross, and communication with the public and elected officials during emergencies. It follows recent incidents including a September 2026 Nor'easter, a January 2026 Sunset Park fire and a July 2026 Rockaway fire.
